name: dragonwood
lore_descriptor: scaled bark, warm to the touch, smelling of smoke
first_pickup_chronicle: Dragonwood. Cut from trees that drank the breath of dragons. Fire passes through it. So do certain other things.
design_notes: F60 peak — wood equivalent of dragonbone. damage_mult 1.25, effective_against dragon (kin-strike). Mid-late tier for staff/club/bow uniques.
